hero.title: Senior Product Manager
paragraphs: Senior **product manager** with nine years in **B2B SaaS**, most recently on platform and integration products for finance teams.
I turn slow, services-heavy workflows into **self-serve products**, and I like problems where **APIs, partners and pricing** meet.
I work closely with engineering and design, run **continuous discovery**, and measure success in **customer outcomes**, not in features shipped.

highlights.title: Onboarding in 9 days
highlights.text: Replaced a consultant-led ERP setup with guided field mapping and sync health checks, cutting time-to-live from 6 weeks to 9 days.

blocks.heading: Context
items: New customers needed a consultant to connect their ERP, and going live took about six weeks.
Onboarding cost capped how many mid-market accounts sales could take on.

blocks.heading: What I did
items: Mapped every manual step in the services playbook together with the onboarding team.
Designed guided field mapping with sensible defaults for the three most common ERPs.
Added sync health checks so customers could find and fix errors themselves.

blocks.heading: Outcome
items: Time-to-live fell from 6 weeks to 9 days.
Most new accounts now go live without a consultant.

blocks.heading: What I learned
items: The fastest fix was removing steps, not automating them.

highlights.title: Pricing that scales with usage
highlights.text: Introduced a usage-based tier after packaging research; expansion revenue grew 22% year over year with under 2% churn impact.

facts.label: Team
facts.value: 1 squad and a pricing working group

blocks.heading: Context
items: Flat per-seat pricing undercharged fast-growing customers and overcharged small ones.

blocks.heading: What I did
items: Interviewed 30 customers about how they valued dispatch volume.
Modelled three packaging options with finance and sales.
Rolled the usage-based tier out to 1,200 accounts in stages.

blocks.heading: Outcome
items: Expansion revenue up 22% year over year, with churn impact under 2%.

blocks.heading: What I learned
items: Customers accept usage pricing when the unit matches the value they see.

highlights.title: Public API and partner program
highlights.text: Launched the public API and a partner program that grew to 40+ partners; integration-led deals reached 31% of new ARR.

highlights.title: Dispatch rebuilt around the map
highlights.text: Shipped map-based dispatch with scheduling suggestions, cutting dispatcher planning time by 40%.

highlights.title: Self-serve dashboards
highlights.text: Built a self-serve dashboard builder that lifted activation from 18% to 34%.
